hardware.candidate_role: USB/display signer dense-tag review scenario smoke
hardware.tested_state: manual and non-interactive review scenario set includes dense structured tags

procedure: Added the show-dense-tags manual review scenario and included it in the non-interactive review-scenario smoke set.
Ran nSealr/esp32 make ci with 49 Python tests, host-core tests, compileall, and firmware validation.
Exported ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell invocation used for hardware smoke.

Verified idf.py resolved under /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/tools/idf.py, esptool.py resolved under /Users/vincenzo/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.9_env/bin/esptool.py, and idf.py --version reported ESP-IDF v5.5.4.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-smoke-review-scenarios against the already-flashed 5280fab firmware image.
expected_result: The attached board accepts the expanded review-scenario protocol smoke, including the dense-tags valid sign_event request, and keeps valid sign_event responses at signing_disabled while rejecting the invalid request with unsupported_request.
observed_result: The ESP32 review scenario smoke passed with 7 scenarios, 8 verified serial exchanges, 7 response frames, and 1 expected rejection frame. Valid review scenarios, including dense tags, returned signing_disabled; the invalid request returned the expected unsupported_request frame.
limitations: This is protocol smoke for the expanded review-scenario set, not a new manual visual inspection of the dense-tags page on the physical display.
The firmware image was not rebuilt or reflashed for this report; it reused the already-flashed 5280fab image because only smoke tooling and documentation changed.

The run does not validate production trusted-display acceptance, production physical-control acceptance, key provisioning, storage, secure boot, flash encryption, debug lock, companion signed-output verification, or real signing.
sign_event is expected to remain signing_disabled until every production signing gate is satisfied.
